articles.title: London Stock Exchange to work with Payward to bring biggest UK stocks onchain
articles.snippet: The LSE is working with Kraken owner Payward, the developer of the xStocks tokenized equities framework, to bring top U.K.-listed stocks onchain.

articles.title: London Stock Exchange partners with Kraken parent for tokenized UK stocks: FT
articles.snippet: The London bourse operator is seeking to offer 24/5 exposure to UK-based tokenized equities, as more TradFi institutions explore tokenized equities offerings.
